"''What?|Pono to two technicians|}} '''Pono''' was a [[human]] security official that worked in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. In [[2 BBY]] he rushed to shut down the Senate feed to prevent [[Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s speech denouncing the [[Ghorman Massacre]] from being broadcast. ==Biography== ===Managing Reporters=== {{Quote|Ronni Goo...''"
"''-Goo-ja.''"
"''Did someone call it in?''"
"''Mid-Rim Network''"
"''I see that. I just don't have a bay assigned for you. You'll have to float this morning.|Pono to Cassian Andor traveling under the alias Ronni Googe|}} Pono was a [[human]] who worked as a security official at the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. In [[2 BBY]] he was working at a wrap around kiosk in the Senate building when [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] approached him while using the alias Ronni Googe a [[journalist]] with [[Mid Rim News|Mid-Rim News]]. After examining his [[scandoc]], Pono allowed Andor through stating that he didn't have a bay assigned to the reporter so he would have to float. ===Shutting down the feed=== [[File:PonoShuttingDownTheFeed-WelcomeToTheRebellion.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Pono shutting down the Senate broadcast feed]] Immediately following [[Senior Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]]'s invocation of [[Article 17-252]] to allow Senior [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] to speak, Pono was ordered to shut down the Senate fee by [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Lagret]] on Imperial Authority. After rushing from his broadcast checkpoint to the senate broadcast room Pono quickly discovered that the room was locked. He proceeded to call two [[technician]] to the door. One of which, [[Jeen]], informed him that they had fixed the door the previous day which had not been locked all session despite protocols requiring it to be. Demanding that they open it, Jeen told him that it required the sequence key which was in the security office. Hearing this, Pono immediately rushed off to the security office to get the key. After retrieving the sequence key, Pono returned to the security closet where he pulled a large lever shutting down the feed. ==Personality and traits== Pono was a human with light skin, [[color|blue]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]]. ==Equipment== Pono wore a dark blue [[jacket]] over green [[clothing|vest]] and matching dark blue shirt and pants. He wore a pin bearing the [[Imperial crest]] on his jacket and wore black belt. ==Behind the scenes== Pono was portrayed by [[James Northcote]] in the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', appearing in the ninth episode of its [[Andor Season 2|second season]], "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=პონო }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Personnel of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Security personnel]]
